articles.title_en: St. Petersburg Car Blast Kills Russian Aerospace Forces Officer
articles.lead_en: The officer was the second Russian military official to be killed in a car bomb explosion in the same neighborhood this year.

articles.title_en: Russian colonel killed in car explosion in St. Petersburg
articles.lead_en: A car exploded in St. Petersburg’s Shushary district, killing a Russian colonel who was behind the wheel.
